theorem: Dimension at least twelve requires at least four bath qubits. Encoding the twelve-level system in four qubits, four disjoint two-qubit SWAP gates implement register SWAP in depth one and time pi/(2g) at per-edge strength g. Under a global sum-norm budget G the same construction takes 2pi/G. For an arbitrary encoded strict Hamiltonian, the manifestly energy-conserving generator g S_register is an eight-qubit interaction; the 2-local gate generator need not conserve that energy at intermediate times.
